name: Kaveh Akbari Hamed
title: Associate Professor; Agile Robots for Control, Optimization, and Learning Lab director
fitReason: Strong real-legged-systems and safe autonomy fit, with online learned human-intent parameters within shared control. Current portfolio leans model-based control more than foundation-model policy learning.

physicalEvidence.summary: September 26, 2025 teleoperator-aware adaptive NMPC paper validates a Unitree Go2 in 48 physical trials with 12 operators navigating ten obstacles. Projected gradient descent updates a Boltzmann human-action model from joystick commands; high-level safety NMPC feeds dynamics-aware MPC and whole-body control. This is online parametric intent learning, not a learned neural locomotion policy. Current ARCOL inventory independently lists two Go2s, three A1s, Kinova arms and motion capture. March 2026 distributed-MPC work supplies fresh physical multi-quadruped research activity, but is not relabeled as ML.

shortVisit.summary: Official faculty and ARCOL pages confirm PI role and current PhD/MS advisees. No current external-master’s short-visit invitation was found in the reviewed pages or focused recruitment search.
